summary: SentinelOne filed an 8-K reporting completion, on October 16, 2026, of a private offering of $1.25 billion aggregate principal of 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due October 1, 2031, including full exercise of the $187.5 million initial purchasers' option. The notes are senior unsecured obligations under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee, bearing no regular interest with contingent special interest payable semiannually from April 1, 2027. Conversion is conditioned on stock-price or trading-price thresholds and other customary triggers. This is a routine financing and unregistered equity-linked issuance, not a special situation; watch conversion-price overhang and any concurrent capped-call or note-hedge disclosures.
